test_title: RRB ALP CBT-I 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 29 Nov, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
In a certain code language, 

 

A + B means 'A is the mother of B', 

A − B means 'A is the brother of B', 

A × B means 'A is the wife of B', and 

A ÷ B means 'A is the father of B'. 

 

Based on the above, how is Q related to T if 'P × Q ÷ R − S + T'?
solution:

P × Q ⇒ F is the wife of Q.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/54d570f31fb3580fa56a7302336fd2abe09853c65be0d2b74853aa0d875856b7.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/73d95aeb3955d283462f51f9e0483f15fe1c3331a363dc2006dcb1812620b8e9.png] 

Q ÷ R ⇒ Q is the father of R.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7dbbdad84a6d72d58a30f5b895e53f1b4765b2a5b229bf37312c9b99e4ea610e.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8cfec4587b22f3f255b8eb3491058b2d066b810318ef2bd4d8a07ad32341b1e7.png] 

R − S ⇒ R is the brother of S.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4c90363622daa5b36afa98ddf7df1485e00420cd03fec49901c919296d7bed48.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f83b61144d1bdc63246e6d0d98b82ab46e98ad1d7cb7b588dcedc1147d559302.png] 

S + T ⇒ S is the mother of T.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/56b28a54ef89f893237e1e8cfeaf2f63f89ab55d19e6e5f5a6dc24550e6d1fcb.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3ce525700816ad0d1d006b2ff299054803dfefe6490334edefbbb1766204d642.png] 

Thus, Q is T's mother's father or maternal grandfather.

Hence, "Option 1" is the correct answer.
